visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of vibrant orange, freshly steamed pumpkin wedges resting in a circular stainless steel steamer pot, with visible condensation and steam rising gently. (2) A transition shows the pumpkin pieces being processed in a black food processor, which quickly whirls them into a smooth, thick orange pulp against a clean, white-marbled kitchen background. (3) The scene shifts to a cream-colored stand mixer where a dough hook is kneading a soft, pale yellow pumpkin-infused dough, showcasing its smooth texture. (4) A woman’s hands are shown pulling a piece of the yellow dough apart to demonstrate its elasticity and the windowpane effect; the lighting is bright and natural. (5) The woman, dressed in a beige knit sweater, is seen pouring dough onto a marble countertop and kneading it with rhythmic, skilled hand motions. (6) A close-up follows of her mixing a white cream and sugar filling in a stainless steel bowl with a white silicone spatula. (7) Small cylinders of butter are cut and placed into flattened dough discs, followed by a dollop of the prepared white cream filling. (8) The woman folds the dough around the filling into uniform balls and arranges them into round baking pans lined with parchment paper. (9) Using a pastry brush, she applies a glaze to the dough and decorates each piece with sliced almonds and pumpkin seeds. (10) Wearing striped heat-resistant oven mitts, she retrieves the baked, golden-brown bread from a black oven, smiling at the camera. (11) The final shot shows the soft bread being pulled apart, revealing a steaming interior and a melted core.

(3) The narrator's speech exhibits moderate pitch variability as she recounts her children's picky eating habits; subtle sounds of utensils hitting a metal bowl are audible in the background. (6) The video concludes with the tactile, crispy sound of the bread crust being pulled apart, accompanied by the narrator's cheerful closing invitation to the viewers.
